description: This file contains bash script functions for logging, error handling, and stack tracing used in Kubernetes scripts.

methods.name: kube::log::errexit
methods.description: Handles automatic script exit on error, printing error info and stack trace.

methods.name: kube::log::install_errexit
methods.description: Sets up trap for ERR to invoke errexit handler.

methods.name: kube::log::stack
methods.description: Prints the call stack for debugging.

methods.name: kube::log::error_exit
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits with specified code.

methods.name: kube::log::error
methods.description: Logs an error message without exiting.

methods.name: kube::log::usage_from_stdin
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin and prints as usage message.

methods.name: kube::log::info
methods.description: Prints informational messages based on verbosity level.

methods.name: kube::log::info_from_stdin
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin and logs as info messages.

methods.name: kube::log::status
methods.description: Prints a formatted status line with timestamp.

methods.name: kube::log::run
methods.description: Logs and executes a command in a subshell.
